about: clip-move kinds: the numbers behind every version of the clip-move part (motion-kit shelf/camera/clip-move.jsx): moves on ONE footage layer, the HyperFrames keyframes skill's 'creator editing' rows rebuilt natively in Rebuilds/hf-keyframes-demo (build.jsx, keyframes-demo.ecproj, renders/NN-*.mp4), approved by Elias 5 Nov 2026 ('good as built'; row 03 Ken Burns dropped, row 05 whip pan is zoom-cut whip-pan, rows 07 / 08 are scene-cut linear-wipe, point-iris, split-handoff). Plain data, no code.

schema.time: every t is SECONDS after `at` (the kind's first frame, frame 0 of the approved comp); a caller snaps at + t to its comp's frames (round), so any fps works
schema.fps / frames: the approved comp (hf-keyframes-demo, 29.97 fps) and its length
schema.builtCentre: [960, 440]: the subject point the framings and the square were built on (Dharya's face in the demo footage); a call's `centre` (default the frame centre [960, 540]) moves every framing point and mask rect by centre − builtCentre, then each is clamped back inside the frame
schema.frame: {t, v: [[scale %, [x, y]] (show point x, y of the 1920x1080 shot at the frame centre at that scale; clamped so no frame edge shows)], ease: [one per segment: a Graph name | 'linear' (the value holds or is untouched) | 'hold' (a hold keyframe: a one-frame jump at the next key)]}: a 'ClipMove <kind> Frame' Transform effect on the shot (anchor [0, 0], position + uniform scale keyed, a straight path), never the shot's own transform
schema.mask: {t, v: [[x0, y0, x1, y1] px of the 1920x1080 shot], ease}: a 'ClipMove <kind> Crop' rect mask on the shot (layer space), keyed
schema.bg: #rrggbb: a 'ClipMove <kind> BG' solid right below the shot while the mask crops it (a call's bg: false leaves what is under the shot)
schema.remap: {t, seg: [one per segment: {rate} (constant speed, × 1) | {hold: true} (a frozen frame: a hold keyframe) | {ramp: true} (the speed changes smoothly from speed[i] to speed[i + 1]: keys.velocity in / out = speed, influence % on both sides; the source advances by the mean speed × the segment)], speed?: [one per key], influence?}: time remapping on the shot's picture; before `at` and after the last key the picture plays at 1×; its sound stays at 1× on an audio-only copy
schema.beats: [{t, id, what, kind: start | peak | cut | land, marker? (a layer marker 'ClipMove <kind> <marker>' on the shot at markerAt, else at t)}]: the hits (<id>-<beat id>)

punch.title: Punch in / out
punch.from: HyperFrames keyframes skill, creator editing row 1 (Punch-in / punch-out)
punch.looks: The shot jumps 100 → 130 % on the subject (a one-frame hard punch-in at 0.9 s), jumps back out at 1.8 s, then punches in smoothly over 0.7 s (Expo In-Out) at 2.3 s and holds. Edges clamped: never a frame edge.
punch.use: Emphasis on a word or a beat in a talking head: hard punches on a joke or a hit word, the smooth one on a building point.

zoom-ladder.title: Zoom ladder
zoom-ladder.from: HyperFrames keyframes skill, creator editing row 2 (Multi-state zoom)
zoom-ladder.looks: A pose ladder on one shot: wide 100 % → medium 130 % → close-up 160 % → an off-centre reframe at 115 %, each step 18–21 frames on Expo In-Out with 12–15 frame holds between. Edges clamped.
zoom-ladder.use: A point that builds: each step closer as the line gets more personal or important, then a reframe to make room (for a graphic on the other side).

chain.title: Chained camera moves
chain.from: HyperFrames keyframes skill, creator editing row 4 (Chained camera moves)
chain.looks: Four labelled beats on one shot: push in to 140 % on the subject → pan right at 160 % → pan left and tilt down → pull back to 100 %, each 21–24 frames on Expo In-Out with ~12 frame holds; a layer marker names each beat. Edges clamped.
chain.use: A tour of one frame: what is on the left, what is on the right, then the whole picture (a screen recording, a desk, a whiteboard, a wide shot).

crop-reframe.title: Crop reframe
crop-reframe.from: HyperFrames keyframes skill, creator editing row 6 (Crop and mask reframe)
crop-reframe.looks: A mask on the shot reframes it without moving it: the full 16:9 frame closes to a 9:16 vertical strip (21 f, Expo In-Out), holds, then to a 1:1 square on the subject (21 f, Expo In-Out) and holds; a dark #08080b background behind.
crop-reframe.use: 'Here's the vertical version', a format change, isolating the speaker before a graphic takes the freed space.

retime.title: Constant retime
retime.from: HyperFrames keyframes skill, creator editing row 9 (Constant retime)
retime.looks: The picture plays at 0.5× for 2 s, then jumps to 2× for 2 s (a hard change of speed, the picture continuous), then 1× again. Picture only: the sound stays at 1× on an audio copy, so after the move the picture runs 1 s ahead of it.
retime.use: Slow-mo on a moment worth seeing, then fast-forward through the boring part.

speed-ramp.title: Speed ramp
speed-ramp.from: HyperFrames keyframes skill, creator editing row 10 (Speed ramp)
speed-ramp.looks: Time remap with continuous speed: 1× → ramps down to 0.25× slow-mo in 0.5 s → holds 0.8 s → ramps up to 2.5× in 0.4 s → holds 0.6 s → back to 1× in 0.4 s (33 % influence on every key). Picture only: the sound stays at 1× on an audio copy (the picture ends 0.56 s ahead of it).
speed-ramp.use: A beat to savour (slow-mo on the action), then whoosh on to the next one; sport, product, b-roll.

freeze.title: Freeze / hold
freeze.from: HyperFrames keyframes skill, creator editing row 11 (Freeze / hold)
freeze.looks: The shot plays 1.5 s, freezes on a frame for 1.5 s (a hold keyframe on the time remap: no zoom, flash or sound effect), then resumes at 1×. Picture only: the sound keeps playing through the freeze on an audio copy (the picture is 1.5 s behind it after).
freeze.use: Freeze on a face or a moment to comment on it, a 'record scratch' beat, a freeze before a graphic lands.
